summary: One church, St. Cyril of Jerusalem, Jamison. Weekend (Sat 4 PM; Sun 8, 10, Noon), daily 9 AM Mon-Sat, Saturday 3-3:45 confession and Adoration (Mon-Fri 9:30-12:30, Wed 7:30-8:30 PM, Daily Mass Chapel) agree in both issues and on the website. Dated Advent penance service, Dec 23 confessions and the 2026 Christmas/New Year schedule are recorded; open: whether to add the Christmas Eve Mass after the 3:30 PM tableau (leaning leave out).

sources.said: Thursday, December 24 3:30pm ~Tableau followed by Mass
participate in the childrens choir or Christmas tableau on Christmas eve, December 24 at 3:30PM

slots.rationale: R30: 3:30 PM is the Tableau's time; the Mass follows it and has no start of its own (POLICY, Final source checks; as queen-of-peace-ardsley s16). Unlike immaculate-conception-bvm-jenkintown s21, where the parish dated the Mass itself at 3:30 after a short procession, here p3 dates only the tableau, a children's pageant that may run some time. Leaning to leave out: a wrong time is worse than a missing one.
slots.question: Add a Christmas Eve Mass at 3:30 PM, which follows the children's Tableau?

sources.said: Holy Days: 6:30 AM, 9:00 AM & 7:00 PM - Vigil: 5:30 PM

As st-isaac-jogues-wayne s27; update mode will read December issues.
